COMPRESS-250.label: I
COMPRESS-250.reason: This is in the compression package, but it concerns Gzip output configuration, not BZip2 input/decompression behavior. No shared failure mechanism beyond very broad “compression” domain.

COMPRESS-246.label: I
COMPRESS-246.reason: Snappy decompressor tracking is a different codec and a different feature area. It offers almost no regional or mechanism overlap with truncated BZip2 stream reading.

COMPRESS-245.label: P
COMPRESS-245.reason: This is in the archive/compression input-stream reading path and involves premature end-of-data behavior, which is mechanistically closer to truncated-stream handling. However, it is Tar/GZIP archive extraction rather than BZip2 decompression, so the overlap is mainly regional and about stream iteration/EOF handling, not the same faulty logic.
